tracks.title: Smoke and Shadows
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
Smoke curls up like a ghost in the air
A whisper
A laugh
It don’t have a care
The moon’s just a dime
Flicked into the night
I’m here with my thoughts
No wrongs
No right

[Chorus]
Take it slow
Let it go
Watch the embers glow
Lose the clock
Lose the weight
Let the moment flow
High above the noise
Where the world feels low
Take it slow
Let it go
Let the embers glow

[Verse 2]
The trees are swayin’ like they’re in on the joke
The stars are winking
The night’s gone rogue
I’m a kite with no string
Just riding the breeze
No map
No plans
Just me and the trees

[Bridge]
Every breath feels like a song
Every thought drifts right
Then wrong
The world’s so loud
But here I’m free
Just smoke and shadows
Just you and me

[Chorus]
Take it slow
Let it go
Watch the embers glow
Lose the clock
Lose the weight
Let the moment flow
High above the noise
Where the world feels low
Take it slow
Let it go
Let the embers glow

[Outro]
The sun will rise
But not just yet
I’m not done with this silhouette
Smoke and shadows
Let me stay
In this quiet
Floating gray

tracks.rawText:
3:50Spokev5neo-psychedelia 
Reggae Fusiónmario9PublishRemix
tracks.title: Spoke
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
I spoke to the moon it just laughed in my face
Said you're chasing shadows in a starless race
I yelled at the sun it just burned my name
Said boy you're running wild in a losing game

[Chorus]
Spoke to the wind it howled back loud
Said don’t you stop now don’t you lose that crowd
Spoke to the night it whispered stay awake
Life’s a game of chances every move’s a stake

[Verse 2]
I called up the rain it just fell in sheets
Said wash it all down but don’t rinse repeat
I asked the mountains they stood there mute
Like statues of silence in a world acute

[Bridge]
Spoke to my shadow it walked away
Said you don’t need me on a brighter day
Spoke to my heart it skipped a beat
Said you’ll find the rhythm when you move your feet

[Chorus]
Spoke to the wind it howled back loud
Said don’t you stop now don’t you lose that crowd
Spoke to the night it whispered stay awake
Life’s a game of chances every move’s a stake

[Outro]
Spoke to the void it just echoed back
Said you’ll find your way on a different track
Spoke to myself and I finally knew
Every word I spoke was the truth breaking through

tracks.title: 6 Quantum Luxuriou (Cover)
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro]
I walk through mirrors made of mercury, no reflection left of me,
my shadow drifts in velvet light, measuring the pulse of what will be.

[Verse 1]
Gold begins to tremble when I think,
the moon repeats my tone in sync,
every atom on the brink
asks what secret I invent.

[Pre-Chorus]
I don’t shine — I dissolve,
a prism where desires evolve,
through every glance I solve the code,
each look a spell, each breath unfolds.

[Chorus]
Quantum Luxurios — my skin’s a code divine,
my voice a liquid oracle in time,
I breathe out galaxies, I exhale rhythm,
everything I touch turns infinite within.

[Verse 2]
My steps bend distance into shape,
my perfume hums in resonant waves,
every word I choose to say
dances in elegance born of chaos.

[Bridge]
In my chest, a quiet reactor glows,
melting time with every tone,
kiss me once — the clocks implode,
the universe adopts my voice.

[Outro]
I am the velvet singularity,
the equation of desire and gravity,
don’t search — I already own your dream,
I am the pulse between the seams.

tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
Sky above me painted in blue
Clouds like whispers breaking through
I’m standing still the world’s a blur

[Prechorus]
The air feels heavy but light to breathe
Every moment hangs like a leaf

[Chorus]
Oh sky sky above me
Hold my dreams set them free
Oh sky sky above me
Endless wide eternity

[Verse 2]
Stars are hiding but I know they’re there
Winking secrets in the midnight air
I chase the moon it laughs and runs

[Bridge]
Sky you’re a canvas splashed with fire
A quiet muse a bold desire
You keep my feet but lift my eyes
Your weightless pull your boundless ties

[Chorus]
Oh sky sky above me
Hold my dreams set them free
Oh sky sky above me
Endless wide eternity

tracks.lyrics:
Verso 1
Soy raíz que siente el viento,
agua clara, fuego lento.
Mi voz viene de la tierra,
donde el alma nunca cierra.

Coro
Zaira Maricrú, del sol nací,
luna y tambor viven en mí.
Canto pa’ curar, pa’ florecer,
del barro vengo, y al cielo volveré.

Verso 2
Verde el mundo me respira,
mis pasos siembran melodía.
No hay frontera, no hay final,
todo vibra en espiral.

Coro final
Zaira Maricrú, de la Tierra soy,
raíz y luz, donde voy, voy.
Canto al fuego, canto al mar,
libre espíritu, nunca dejará de amar.

tracks.title: Smoke and Shadows (Cover)
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
Smoke curls up like a ghost in the air
A whisper
A laugh
It don’t have a care
The moon’s just a dime
Flicked into the night
I’m here with my thoughts
No wrongs
No right

[Chorus]
Take it slow
Let it go
Watch the embers glow
Lose the clock
Lose the weight
Let the moment flow
High above the noise
Where the world feels low
Take it slow
Let it go
Let the embers glow

[Verse 2]
The trees are swayin’ like they’re in on the joke
The stars are winking
The night’s gone rogue
I’m a kite with no string
Just riding the breeze
No map
No plans
Just me and the trees

[Bridge]
Every breath feels like a song
Every thought drifts right
Then wrong
The world’s so loud
But here I’m free
Just smoke and shadows
Just you and me

[Chorus]
Take it slow
Let it go
Watch the embers glow
Lose the clock
Lose the weight
Let the moment flow
High above the noise
Where the world feels low
Take it slow
Let it go
Let the embers glow

[Outro]
The sun will rise
But not just yet
I’m not done with this silhouette
Smoke and shadows
Let me stay
In this quiet
Floating gray

tracks.title: Driftwood Dreams
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
Salt on my skin waves in my veins
A whispering breeze hums soft refrains
The ocean calls me by my name

[Chorus]
Sea sea set me free
Carry my heart where it longs to be
Sea sea endlessly
Your tide’s a song that sings to me

[Verse 2]
Sand in my hair stars in my sight
The moon’s reflection a borrowed light
I walk the edge of day and night

[Prechorus]
Foam fades away just like the past
Each wave whispers nothing lasts

[Chorus]
Sea sea set me free
Carry my heart where it longs to be
Sea sea endlessly
Your tide’s a song that sings to me

[Bridge]
Driftwood floats like dreams untold
Shells hide secrets the deep won’t unfold
The waves they crash but still they hold

tracks.lyrics:
(Intro)
Yeah… vibra positiva en la mañana,
BlackMamba en la pista, y el Jorge en la balanza.
Money con conciencia, flow con elegancia,
Semillas de hoy pa’ cosechar confianza.

(Verso 1)
Mueve la mente, no solo la lana,
él te enseña a invertir con calma, sin drama.
Retiro seguro, futuro que llama,
visión de acero, corazón de rama.

(Coro)
Jorge Christian, vibra real,
mezcla números con espiritual.
Ahorra con ritmo natural,
invierte en ti, vibra vital.

(Verso 2)
Sabe que el tiempo es oro pero también arte,
planifica el sueño sin perder el parte.
Consultor con ritmo, no vende humo,
te guía al sol sin perder el rumbo.

(Bridge)
Flow financiero, pero sin ego,
respeto primero, ese es el juego.
Si el dinero fluye, que fluya sincero,
la música cura, el plan es entero.

(Coro Final)
Jorge Christian, vibra real,
mezcla números con espiritual.
Ahorra con ritmo natural,
invierte en ti, vibra vital.

(Outro)
BlackMamba al micro, el beat suena fino,
reggae de conciencia pa’ cambiar el destino.
De la mente al bolsillo, del alma al camino,
que el sol te guíe, hermano divino. ☀️

tracks.style: Reggae clásico de los años 80 con influencias dancehall, ritmo relajado pero enérgico, bajo profundo y cálido, batería con patrón one-drop, guitarra rítmica con staccato, arreglos con teclados tipo órgano jamaicano y toques de sintetizador vintage, voces melódicas y expresivas con estilo caribeño, atmósfera festiva y positiva, mezcla con sensación analógica y reverb espacial
tracks.lyrics:
🎵 “Código Infinito (para Oscar T.)”

(Verso 1)
Línea por línea, va forjando su reino,
del bug al milagro, del cero al trueno.
Un loop de veinte años de fuego constante,
entre bits y sueños, siempre adelante.

(Pre-coro)
El teclado suena como una guitarra,
compila el alma, su mente dispara.
No hay error que no transforme en arte,
su código vibra, su juego parte.

(Coro)
Código infinito, alma binaria,
de la fábrica al cosmos, su ruta diaria.
Con Unity y C#, levanta universos,
jugando a ser dios en versos inmersos.

(Verso 2)
Mentor de la flama, maestro en la arena,
el tiempo lo llama, su mente resuena.
Black & Pink arde, la noche se enciende,
la pasión del dev nunca se pierde.

(Puente)
Azure en el cielo, docker en la marea,
sus pipelines fluyen, la idea no flaquea.
De Flex a Photon, de nube a motor,
su código late con ritmo y valor.

(Coro final)
Código infinito, alma binaria,
rompe el destino con fe legendaria.
Oscar programó su vida al compás,
del pixel al alma… nunca se irá.

(Outro)
🎮
Y cuando el mundo pregunte quién fue,
dirá el juego: “fue él.”

tracks.lyrics:
🎵 “Cosmic Code (for Brian G.)”

(Verse 1)
Between cells and equations, the fire ignites,
the notebook shines, his mind takes flight.
From kernel to cosmos, expanding the zone,
Jupyter hums — the code is his throne.

(Pre-Chorus)
No wall divides science and art,
each line of code a brand-new start.
Data dancing in sacred design,
every output — a spark divine.

(Chorus)
Brian Granger, writing lightning,
every loop a thought enlightening.
Between Python and the stars above,
he opens portals made of love.

(Verse 2)
From the cloud rains bits of wonder,
open science breaks the thunder.
Revolution born from free creation,
his code’s a hymn to innovation.

(Bridge)
Plot by plot, the universe breathes,
time bends softly in tangled weaves.
Jupyter sings, dimensions align,
the math turns rhythm, the code divine.

(Final Chorus)
Brian Granger, writing lightning,
every loop a thought enlightening.
Between Python and the stars above,
he opens portals made of love.
Cosmic code, infinite mind —
the kernel awakes, the light refined.

tracks.rawText: 2:15Título: "Ya No Me Duele"v5Ska Rock Latino3PublishRemix
tracks.title: Título: "Ya No Me Duele"
tracks.lyrics:
Título: "Ya No Me Duele"
(ska moderno, ritmo 2-tone con toques latinos y guitarras funk)

Verso 1
Te llevaste mis domingos grises,
mis canciones tristes también.
Pero el sol volvió en mi ventana,
y aprendí a quererme bien.

Pre-Coro
Quemé las fotos, cerré el bar,
le puse ritmo a mi pesar.

Coro
Ya no me duele, no, no, no,
ni tu sombra me hace temblar.
Ya no me duele, no, no, no,
mi corazón volvió a bailar.

Verso 2
Te busqué en cada esquina rota,
me perdí, pero al final...
descubrí que el dolor se agota
cuando uno deja de esperar.

Puente (break con metales y coros)
Eh-oh, eh-oh, ya no me duele más.
Eh-oh, eh-oh, voy a celebrar.

Coro final (doble tempo)
Ya no me duele, no, no, no,
ni tu sombra me hace temblar.
Ya no me duele, no, no, no,
mi corazón volvió a bailar.

(Fade con trompetas y risas de fondo)

tracks.style: Electro-industrial / cyber-techno track at 128 BPM. Male vocal, confident and sharp, robotic harmonies on chorus. Theme: “Disciplined Dragon — controlled chaos, power, precision, self-mastery.” Metallic synths, distorted bass, rising tension, cinematic breakdown halfway.
tracks.lyrics:
🎧 Title: “Disciplined Dragon”

[Verse 1]
Woke in the static, fire in my veins,
Chrome in my heart, I don’t feel the chains.
Breath of the beast, code in the storm,
Order in chaos, that’s how I’m born.

[Pre-Chorus]
No spell, no saint, no savior call,
I break my limits, I build my wall.
Every glitch, a sacred tone,
Every fault becomes my throne.

[Chorus]
I’m a disciplined dragon — blaze in control,
Steel in my rhythm, fever in my soul.
When the world goes wild, I just ignite,
Precision in fury, I burn it right.

[Verse 2]
Digital lungs, I breathe the bass,
Circuits scream but keep their grace.
Fear’s a ghost, I make it kneel,
Lightning learns my will of steel.

[Bridge]
No mercy mode, I ride the spark,
Balance born from the endless dark.
Between the zeros, I find my sound,
A dragon awake where the lost are found.

[Final Chorus]
I’m a disciplined dragon — blaze in control,
Steel in my rhythm, fever in my soul.
No chaos wasted, no drop in vain,
I tame the storm inside my brain.

tracks.rawText: 3:49Mirror skin, data glow,v5Electro-Fashion / Neo-Trance1PublishRemix
tracks.title: Mirror skin, data glow,
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Mirror skin, data glow,
Neon veins begin to flow,
Static whispers in my spine,
You and I, we cross the line.

[Pre-Chorus]
Silk of light beneath my tongue,
Every shadow comes undone,
Heart in pixels, beat in chrome,
Blacklight calling me back home.

[Chorus]
Blacklight—burn my name in code,
Turn the dark to liquid gold,
Dancing where the silence folds,
Blacklight, I’m in control.

[Drop / Hook]
(Wordless vocal: “Ah-ah, ah-ah, blacklight”)
Pulse ignite,
We ride the night,
Under the ultraviolet sky.

[Verse 2]
Velvet air, magnetic dust,
Bodies bending into trust,
Zero-gravity design,
Time dissolves, the world’s aligned.

[Bridge]
Feel the circuit start to pray,
Binary gods fade away,
Only rhythm, only breath,
Only love that cheats the death.

[Chorus 2 / Final]
Blacklight—burn my name in code,
Turn the dark to liquid gold,
You’re the glitch I can’t decode,
Blacklight, my only mode.

[Outro]
(Beat fades with reversed synth echoes)
Light… inside the black…

tracks.lyrics:
🎵 Title: “Architect of the New World”
(by BlackMamba x Alicia Keys vibe)

(Verse 1)
He don’t build with steel or stone,
He’s drawing futures in the unknown.
Where love’s the blueprint, peace the plan,
He’s healing hearts with open hands.

(Pre-Chorus)
Oh, every tear becomes a sign,
Every voice a sacred line.
He’s not chasing gold or fame,
He’s rewriting how we play the game.

(Chorus)
He’s the architect of a new world,
Lifting souls like flags unfurled.
Turning pain into design,
Making heaven in our minds.

(Verse 2)
See, he walks where silence speaks,
Where power bows and wisdom peaks.
Teaching hearts to see the code,
Of light and truth down every road.

(Bridge)
Oh, can you feel the rise inside?
The world awakening tonight.
No fear, no walls, no hate, no fight—
Just the rhythm of the right.

(Final Chorus)
He’s the architect of a new world,
Building love where lies were hurled.
A mirror made of hope and grace,
A fire shining through the human race.

(Outro)
We are the walls, we are the sky,
We are the reason, the reason why.
And he’s the architect, mmm,
Of the love we’re born to find.

tracks.title: Smoke and Shadows (Cover) (Cover) (Cover)
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
Smoke curls up like a ghost in the air
A whisper
A laugh
It don’t have a care
The moon’s just a dime
Flicked into the night
I’m here with my thoughts
No wrongs
No right

[Chorus]
Take it slow
Let it go
Watch the embers glow
Lose the clock
Lose the weight
Let the moment flow
High above the noise
Where the world feels low
Take it slow
Let it go
Let the embers glow

[Verse 2]
The trees are swayin’ like they’re in on the joke
The stars are winking
The night’s gone rogue
I’m a kite with no string
Just riding the breeze
No map
No plans
Just me and the trees

[Bridge]
Every breath feels like a song
Every thought drifts right
Then wrong
The world’s so loud
But here I’m free
Just smoke and shadows
Just you and me

[Chorus]
Take it slow
Let it go
Watch the embers glow
Lose the clock
Lose the weight
Let the moment flow
High above the noise
Where the world feels low
Take it slow
Let it go
Let the embers glow

[Outro]
The sun will rise
But not just yet
I’m not done with this silhouette
Smoke and shadows
Let me stay
In this quiet
Floating gray

tracks.rawText: 2:12🎵 “Fuego en los Ojos” – estilo Enanitosv5rock pop boliviano1PublishRemix
tracks.title: 🎵 “Fuego en los Ojos” – estilo Enanitos
tracks.lyrics:
🎵 “Fuego en los Ojos” – estilo Enanitos Verdes / Héroes del Silencio suave

[Verso 1]
Hay hombres y mujeres sin nombre,
que no necesitan hablar,
se les nota el fuego en los ojos,
demasiado tiempo sin parar.

[Pre-Coro]
Cayeron mil veces, pero no se apagó
la chispa que el mundo nunca entendió.

[Coro]
Porque hay derrotas que no quitan fuerza,
solo cambian dirección.
El alma aprende a pelear distinta,
ya no con armas, sino con voz.
Y si la tierra los besó en la cara,
volvieron igual de fieros,
porque quien ya no teme perder,
enciende el cielo entero.

[Verso 2]
El cuerpo envejece, el alma no,
aprende a hablar sin gritar.
Despierta al dormido con su calor,
sin magia, solo verdad.

[Puente]
Sabe que puede mover montañas,
sin manos, solo con fe.
Es el faro de los que dudan,
la llama que no se ve.

[Coro final]
Porque hay derrotas que no matan sueños,
solo cambian el compás.
Un guerrero que vuelve del abismo
ya no teme mirar atrás.

tracks.title: 🎵 “Fuego en los Ojos” – estilo Enanitos
tracks.lyrics:
🎵 “Fuego en los Ojos” – estilo Enanitos Verdes / Héroes del Silencio suave

[Verso 1]
Hay hombres y mujeres sin nombre,
que no necesitan hablar,
se les nota el fuego en los ojos,
demasiado tiempo sin parar.

[Pre-Coro]
Cayeron mil veces, pero no se apagó
la chispa que el mundo nunca entendió.

[Coro]
Porque hay derrotas que no quitan fuerza,
solo cambian dirección.
El alma aprende a pelear distinta,
ya no con armas, sino con voz.
Y si la tierra los besó en la cara,
volvieron igual de fieros,
porque quien ya no teme perder,
enciende el cielo entero.

[Verso 2]
El cuerpo envejece, el alma no,
aprende a hablar sin gritar.
Despierta al dormido con su calor,
sin magia, solo verdad.

[Puente]
Sabe que puede mover montañas,
sin manos, solo con fe.
Es el faro de los que dudan,
la llama que no se ve.

[Coro final]
Porque hay derrotas que no matan sueños,
solo cambian el compás.
Un guerrero que vuelve del abismo
ya no teme mirar atrás.

tracks.title: gold painted (Edit) (Remix)
tracks.lyrics:
**"Drama queen in your smoke-built throne,
screaming high above—down here, you're overthrown.
Your echo’s just dust in the wind,
a fading scream where your reign should’ve been.

You crave the cheers, no matter who they’re from,
but your crown’s just plastic sprayed to look like gold.
Fake shine, brittle bones,
glitter peeling under the weight you can’t hold.

You built your empire on borrowed applause,
fed by mirrors and paper-thin walls.
But every mask slips, every script burns,
and truth has a way of taking its turn.

So keep waving from your castle of haze,
while the ground crumbles under your praise.
’Cause when the smoke clears, you’ll stand alone—
a drama queen with no more throne."**

tracks.title: Whispers Between Sleep and Light
tracks.lyrics:
Sleep, sleep and dream to have
A life without temptation’s grasp

[Verse 1]
Of golden dreams and power’s spell
Of judging, though some reason dwells

Greed’s the bondage of the soul
And chains the freedom that makes us whole

May envy never kiss your face
Nor hatred’s arms your heart embrace

[Pre-Chorus]
Sleep, sleep and dream to be
The guardian of your treasure’s key

The love I’ve poured inside of you
A gift you have much to do

[Chorus]
Don’t grow proud with wealth’s bright gleam
Nor sink away in poverty’s stream

Let neither loss nor failure blind
Your eyes — tomorrow’s light you’ll find

[Verse 2]
Sleep, sleep, here I will stay
The clouds your pillow night and day

Let neither wind nor gentle breeze
Stop you from feeling my gentle ease

[Pre-Chorus]
Sleep, sleep and dream to be
The guardian of your treasure’s key

The love I’ve poured inside of you
A gift you have much to do

[Chorus]
Don’t grow proud with wealth’s bright gleam
Nor sink away in poverty’s stream

Let neither loss nor failure blind
Your eyes — tomorrow’s light you’ll find

[Bridge]
Sleep, sleep and dream to have
Sleep, sleep and dream to have

[Outro]
Sleep, sleep and dream to have

tracks.lyrics:
"Silent Betrayal"

Verse 1
Years have passed, the mask still on,
Smiles fake like the breaking dawn.
Blood that binds but cuts so deep,
Promises made that they don't keep.

Pre-Chorus
Whispers cold behind my back,
Lies and shadows on their track.
If I fall, they’ll never care,
As long as their world stays fair.

Chorus
Silent betrayal, family’s game,
Changing faces, all the same.
Wounds that never seem to heal,
Broken trust they never feel.

Verse 2
Time has changed their hearts to stone,
Left me standing all alone.
In their eyes, I’m just a name,
A fading spark, forgotten flame.

Pre-Chorus
Silent screams inside my soul,
A hollow shell, a shattered goal.
If I die, it’s no big deal,
As long as their fate is sealed.

Chorus
Silent betrayal, family’s game,
Changing faces, all the same.
Wounds that never seem to heal,
Broken trust they never feel.

Bridge
Years of pain, years of lies,
Truth buried beneath their ties.
I stand strong, I stand alone,
In this war of flesh and bone.

Outro
Silent betrayal, cold and deep,
In their silence, secrets keep.
If I fall, no one will cry,
While they live, I’m left to die.

Pre-Chorus
Silent screams inside my soul,
A hollow shell, a shattered goal.
If I die, it’s no big deal,
As long as their fate is sealed.

Chorus
Silent betrayal, family’s game,
Changing faces, all the same.
Wounds that never seem to heal,
Broken trust they never feel.

Bridge
Years of pain, years of lies,
Truth buried beneath their ties.
I stand strong, I stand alone,
In this war of flesh and bone.

Outro
Silent betrayal, cold and deep,
In their silence, secrets keep.
If I fall, no one will cry,
While they live, I’m left to die.

The heaviest wounds are carved in silence,

only ashes now remain.

it’s vengeance in sound,
breaking the ground,
burning it down.

The heaviest wounds carved in silence,
a scream they’ll never hear.
The soul burns alone…
…vengeance in sound.

tracks.title: En la penumbra del fuego ancestral,
tracks.style: "A ritual of fire and drums, where folklore meets the dance floor." 🔥🪘"Mexican legend reborn in high-BPM tribal bass.""When the fire dances with the fire of the BlackMamba." 🐍"Dark folklore, deep bass, and the heartbeat of the drum.""This is not just a song. It’s a ritual."
tracks.lyrics:
En la penumbra del fuego ancestral,
Los tambores suenan, la energía es letal.
La serpiente se enreda en la sombra del mar,
El espíritu danza, nos viene a guiar.

Pre-coro
Los ritmos del suelo, la tierra resuena,
El viento es fuego, la luna llena.
Un grito profundo, el eco nos llama,
Las almas se elevan en la llama.

Coro
Ritual de fuego, la noche en trance,
Bajo el manto de la música, todo avanza.
Bass tribal, resuena la danza,
Entre las sombras, el alma alcanza.

Verso 2
Cuerdas vibrantes, el alma despierta,
El fuego consume, la danza no miente.
Épico como el sol al alba,
El espíritu tribal nos envuelve en calma.

Puente
Vibran los ecos, la magia comienza,
El ritmo nos envuelve, es nuestra presencia.
Bajo la tierra, la energía late,
El fuego y la música se entrelazan, se abate.

Coro final
Ritual de fuego, la noche en trance,
Bajo el manto de la música, todo avanza.
Bass tribal, resuena la danza,
Entre las sombras, el alma alcanza.

tracks.rawText: 3:58Quinto Elemento / Llama Vitalv4.5+música prehispánica, rock alternativo, flauta y percusión ritual, tambores prehispanicos, musica prehispanica mexicana ancestral91PublishRemix
tracks.title: Quinto Elemento / Llama Vital
tracks.style: música prehispánica, rock alternativo, flauta y percusión ritual, tambores prehispanicos, musica prehispanica mexicana ancestral.
tracks.lyrics:
En la penumbra, donde el jaguar sueña,
bajo el manto de plumas y viento,
camino sobre ríos que cantan tu eco,
mi fuego respira en el silencio eterno.

Ojo de obsidiana, guardián del misterio,
tu latido escondido en las constelaciones,
danza entre sahumerios y arenas doradas,
florece en la noche la voz que te nombra.

(En la lengua del agua, en el pulso del trueno,
vive el alma que espejea conmigo…)

Iyari, agua, llama de fuego eterno, aire vital,  tierra dorada, ether eterno, amor verdadero,
raíz que me llama desde otros cielos,
corazón de cristal que arde sin consumirse, que todo lo da sin nada esperar, lleno de nada, lleno de vida,  llena de todo mi espiritu , mente, alma, pues es fuego que arrasa, agua que llena mi universo,
te busco en cada horizonte que se abre, en cada universo, cada fragmento que encuentro de ti, una pista para mi, atravez de cada vida mi destino es encontrarnos de nuevo, pues dos dualidades, siempre regresan aunque pasen los tiempos.

tracks.lyrics:
Serpiente Ancestral
(Corazón y Fuego en unión)

(Verso 1) [Cantar con voz profunda, pausada, cargada de reverencia]
Bajo el altar del sol naciente,
arde el espíritu valiente.
Serpiente sagrada que se enrosca,
canta el tiempo, danza y brota.

(Coro) [Voz clara, poderosa, con eco largo, ritmo marcado]
Iyari, corazón que arde,
luz que nace y no se parte.
Sombra y fuego en conjunción,
danza eterna, unión y razón.

(Verso 2) [Voz susurrada y melódica, misterio creciente]
Viento que susurra secretos,
reflejo en antiguos ritos.
Dualidad que se funde y crea,
espíritu que nunca muere.

(Puente) [Casi hablado, con énfasis en “chispa”, “sacrificio”, “fuego”]
Hombre de la chispa divina,
guardián de la llama fina.
Sacrificio que renace,
fuego eterno que nunca cese.

(Coro) [Repetir con más fuerza y sentimiento]
Iyari, corazón que arde,
luz que nace y no se parte.
Sombra y fuego en conjunción,
danza eterna, unión y razón.

(Outro) [Voz baja, etérea, casi un suspiro]
Serpiente y sol en comunión,
raíces de antigua canción.
Iyari, llama y viento,
eco sagrado del tiempo.

tracks.title: Chīchīltikpa Yōllōtl <3
tracks.style:
Tempo: 135 bpm.

Base 4/4 techno con kick potente, hi-hats brillantes y percusión tribal sampleada.

Sintetizadores agresivos, con pads místicos y líneas melódicas inspiradas en flauta.

Voces procesadas con delay, reverb, pitch-shift y filtros para crear atmósfera.

tracks.lyrics:
Chīchīltikpa Yōllōtl
(Serpiente Ancestral - Corazón Ardiente)

(Tlahtolli 1 - Verso 1)
Īka tonatiuh xōchitl āxkatl,
tlakatl īpan yōllōtl īkpatla.
Coatl tlāltikpakā, tletl īpan īxtli,
tlatskanīka in tōnali īpan chīchīltik.

(Kantolli - Coro)
Iyari, yōllōtl tlāltik,
tlakatl īpan yolikān.
Tletl īpan koyotl,
tlahtōlli ik tlamikilistli.

(Tlahtolli 2 - Verso 2)
Īka eheka tlakatl,
chīchīltik ika chīchīltik,
yoli tlen īpan īxiptla,
mēxihkatl in tomi.

(Puente)
Tlakatl īpan tletl,
yollōtl tlatskanīka.
Tletl tlatskanīka,
tlakatl moneki nemi.

(Kantolli - Coro)
Iyari, yōllōtl tlāltik,
tlakatl īpan yolikān.
Tletl īpan koyotl,
tlahtōlli ik tlamikilistli.

(Xochipilli - Outro)
Coatl īpan tonatiuh,
tlatskanīka in mexikayotl.
Iyari, tletl īkpatla,
yollōtl īpan ēka xōchitl.

tracks.lyrics:
Above and Below” – Hybrid Version
(Confession → Ritual Metal)

Verse 1 (soft, intimate)
I’ve been afraid…
of losing the ones I love,
and in the end I saw
I was always losing myself.

I fell so many times I forgot the sky,
and in every fall I kept a secret:
pain can break you…
but it can also set you free.

Chorus 1 (acoustic, melodic)
What is above is like what is below,
and what’s inside of me… reflects in you.
If I heal myself, we will both be whole,
but if I’m lost… we both lose our light.

Verse 2 (growing with light percussion)
I saw in your eyes the shadow that was mine,
I watched you fade when I was hiding.
But I don’t want to run anymore,
I want to come home… with you.

Bridge → transition to metal (whispered, ambient noise, drums rising)
I’m not perfect…
but I’m the only one who can save us.
My chaos will be gold,
and my love… our eternity.

Verse 3 (Metal Balad / Heavy) (distorted guitars, deep bass, drums)
I fell from the sky into the dust,
wounds speaking in ancient tongues.
Fear made me a broken temple,
anger was my blood, hate… my frozen armor.

Pre-Chorus (melodic screams)
Above and below, the shadow is breathing,
I am the stone and fire that never forgets.

Chorus 2 (explosive)
What is above burns in my chest,
what is below bleeds in my body.
If I die within, I’ll be reborn in gold,
my chaos is the crucible where all will burn.

Final (sustained, powerful)
I am shadow and sun, I am mother and wolf,
my soul is the flame that will never drown.
What is above… what is below…
is my truth.

tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
I packed my dreams in a paper bag
Shoes untied and a heart to drag
Clouds are heavy but the sky’s so blue
I’m chasing miles just to find what’s true

[Chorus]
Trip trip tumble and fall
I’m running to nowhere but loving it all
Trip trip catch me if you can
I’m lost but I’m free on this no-plan plan

[Verse 2]
The radio sings but the words don’t stick
A coffee cup cold and the clock won’t tick
Highways whisper like a restless friend
Every bend feels like it might not end

[Prechorus]
But the wind keeps calling
And the stars keep falling

[Chorus]
Trip trip tumble and fall
I’m running to nowhere but loving it all
Trip trip catch me if you can
I’m lost but I’m free on this no-plan plan

[Bridge]
Every stoplight’s a joke I don’t get
Every detour’s a thrill I can’t forget
Gas station dreams in a candy aisle
This whole world’s spinning in my reckless smile

tracks.title: Vaporella
tracks.style: A hypnotic psycodelic tecno track opens with pulsing synth arpeggios and a warped kick, building layers of acidic basslines and swirling effects. Polyrhythmic percussion and evolving modular textures create a trance-like groove, surging through atmospheric breakdowns and explosive drops.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
She drifts through the air like a cloud in disguise
A vapor trail dancing in neon skies
She whispers in colors only silence can see
Vaporella
You're a mystery to me

[Chorus]
Vaporella
Where do you go
In the misty glow
Only you know
You fade
You shine
You blur the line
Vaporella
You're a dream of mine

[Verse 2]
She floats through the cracks where the daylight won't fit
A shimmer
A shadow
A fleeting spirit
Her touch is a secret
Her laugh is a sigh
Vaporella
You're the why behind my why

[Bridge]
Do you live in the static of the midnight air
Do you hum in the wires when no one's there
You're here
You're gone
You're everywhere
Vaporella
I can't compare

[Chorus]
Vaporella
Where do you go
In the misty glow
Only you know
You fade
You shine
You blur the line
Vaporella
You're a dream of mine

[Outro]
Vaporella
Just a trace
Of a world I’ll never face
You slip
You slide
You won't be caught
Vaporella
You're the dream I sought

tracks.title: el sur
tracks.style: Opens with dark orchestral pads and mariachi brass, dropping into heavy, syncopated dubstep basslines layered under rapid-fire gangsta rap verses. Percussion fuses hip hop hats with Latin congas, while cinematic strings add drama between massive drops and epic build-ups.
tracks.lyrics:
(Dubstep / Gangsta Rap / Mexican Groove)

[Intro]
(voz grave con eco)
Soy el jefe…
Del sur al norte, control en el aire…
Lambo negro, cuerno dorado…
Cuidado… que aquí mandamos.

[Verso 1]
Cadenas brillan, sangre fría en la mirada,
Billetes verdes, la calle nunca me falla,
Bajo perfil, pero peso como plomo,
Cuando suena el cuerno, todo el mundo corre pronto.

[Pre-Coro]
Luces rojas, humo en la ventana,
Música tronando, la noche se enciende,
Calle peligrosa, reina mexicana,
Si entras a mi zona, no sales ileso, entiende.

[Coro] (con metales y drop dubstep)
Soy el jefe del sur,
Con mi gente y mi groove,
Trombón suena, bass retumba,
Calles tiemblan, mundo zumba.
Soy el jefe del sur,
Mano firme y sin luz,
En la sombra, mando el juego,
Dubstep, fuego y puro trueno.

[Verso 2]
Desde abajo, ahora brillo en diamantes,
Código de calle, no hables con el cantante,
Rugen motores, tamborazos retumbando,
Bajo y metales, la ciudad está temblando.

[Puente] (break instrumental con trompetas y bajo wobble)
Siluetas en la noche,
Sombras que se mueven…
(Yeah)
No hay miedo, solo leyes…
Que yo mismo escribí.

[Coro – Reprise]
Soy el jefe del sur,
Con mi gente y mi groove,
Trombón suena, bass retumba,
Calles tiemblan, mundo zumba

tracks.title: the boss
tracks.style: dubstep, hiphop, brass latin, gangster, swag
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro]
(deep voice with echo)
I’m the boss…
From south to north, control in the air…
Black Lambo, golden horn…
Careful… we run this here.

[Verse 1]
Chains shining, cold blood in my stare,
Green bills stacking, the streets never fail me,
Low profile, but I’m heavy like lead,
When the horn blows, everybody runs ahead.

[Pre-Chorus]
Red lights, smoke in the window,
Music blasting, the night ignites,
Dangerous streets, Mexican queen,
Step in my zone, you won’t leave clean.

[Chorus] (with brass and dubstep drop)
I’m the boss from the south,

tracks.title: silent
tracks.style: cinematic rock california clasic style, hip hop and dj, happy rock style.
tracks.lyrics:
"Silent Betrayal"

Verse 1
Years have passed, the mask still on,
Smiles fake like the breaking dawn.
Blood that binds but cuts so deep,
Promises made that they don't keep.

Pre-Chorus
Whispers cold behind my back,
Lies and shadows on their track.
If I fall, they’ll never care,
As long as their world stays fair.

Chorus
Silent betrayal, family’s game,
Changing faces, all the same.
Wounds that never seem to heal,
Broken trust they never feel.
Verse 2
Time has changed their hearts to stone,
Left me standing all alone.
In their eyes, I’m just a name,
A fading spark, forgotten flame.

Pre-Chorus
Silent screams inside my soul,
A hollow shell, a shattered goal.
If I die, it’s no big deal,
As long as their fate is sealed.

Chorus
Silent betrayal, family’s game,
Changing faces, all the same.
Wounds that never seem to heal,
Broken trust they never feel.

BridgeYears of pain, years of lies,
Truth buried beneath their ties.
I stand strong, I stand alone,
In this war of flesh and bone.

Outro
Silent betrayal, cold and deep,
In their silence, secrets keep.
If I fall, no one will cry,
While they live, I’m left to die.

Oh no oh no it's a runaway day
Slipping and sliding in a sideways way

Life's just a stain in the sunlight

Birds are offbeat but still flying high
If the world’s off-kilter
So am I

tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
I saw a cat by the purple sea
Its eyes like moons staring back at me
The waves hummed low
A secret song
I stood there wondering where I belong

[Chorus]
Alone with the ocean
The purple tide
A cat for company
Nowhere to hide
The sky whispers
The stars hold their breath
This quiet feels louder than life or death

[Verse 2]
Footprints vanish in the shifting sand
The cat just watches
It understands
A sailor’s ghost in a feline frame
The wind keeps calling
It knows my name

[Bridge]
Purple clouds roll
The horizon bends
Where does it start
Where does it end
A cat purrs softly
The world spins slow
Maybe the ocean’s the only thing I’ll ever know

[Chorus]
Alone with the ocean
The purple tide
A cat for company
Nowhere to hide
The sky whispers
The stars hold their breath
This quiet feels louder than life or death

[Outro]
I asked the cat
But it wouldn’t reply
It just blinked slow under the violet sky
Alone
Yet not
As the waves kissed the shore
The ocean’s a mystery
The cat’s even more

tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
En la sierra me conocen, no por bueno ni por santo
Traigo cicatrices viejas que se hicieron con balazos
Me vendiste la confianza y el respeto por barato
Ahora vienes suplicando
Pero el tiempo ya se ha acabado
Y no hay piedad pa’l que me ha traicionado

[Verse 2]
En la troca voy bajando con la noche de testigo
La neblina es mi cortina y el cuerno mi mejor amigo
Dicen que el que siembra viento cosechará torbellino
Y aquí estoy pa’ confirmarlo
La deuda vengo a cobrarlo
No hay montaña que me pueda detener

[Chorus]
Porque en la sierra, la palabra es la ley
Y el silencio vale más que un papel
No hay retroceso, ya lo decidí
Hoy la luna va a brillar carmesí
Entre pinos y barrancas me verás
Y mi sombra será lo último que mirarás

La familia se resguarda, saben bien lo que yo quiero
La traición es un veneno que corroe hasta los huesos
Y si Dios quiere perdonarte
Ese no será mi caso
Porque el diablo está guiando mi motor

tracks.lyrics:
🔥 “Ritual del BlackMamba” 🔥

[Intro – Canto]
Heya heya heya, ohhh…
Heya heya heya, yaaa…
🔥🐍🔥

[Verso 1]
Luna arriba, fuego en la tierra,
la serpiente sagrada ya se despierta,
el viento lleva tambor y canto,
el águila mira desde lo alto.

[Estribillo – Canto fuerte]
Heya ya heya, BlackMamba levanta,
Heya ya heya, fuego en la mirada,
tambor que truena, corazón de roca,
en este círculo, nadie está sola.

[Verso 2]
Pies en la tierra, manos en la llama,
llamando a los ancestros por su nombre y alma,
danza de sombra, mordida que encanta,
bajo la noche, el bajo retumba y canta.

[Estribillo – repetición]
Heya ya heya, BlackMamba levanta,
Heya ya heya, fuego en la mirada,
tambor que truena, corazón de roca,
en este círculo, nadie está sola.

[Outro – susurro]
Heya… heya… ohhh…
El ritual… ha comenzado.

tracks.lyrics:
The ravens call
Their wings like blades
A shadow falls
The light cascades
Blood on the stone
Whispers rise
A god unseen with hollow eyes

[Chorus]
Odin waits where the fire meets the sea
A storm of war
A fate to decree
Raise your swords
Let the drums begin
For the rituals of the raven king

[Verse 2]
In Kattegat
The flames run wild
A warrior's heart
The gods beguiled
The spears they clash
The shields collide
No peace for those with Odin’s pride

[Prechorus]
Skål to the fallen
Skål to the brave
The pyres burn
No soul to save

[Chorus]
Odin waits where the fire meets the sea
A storm of war
A fate to decree
Raise your swords
Let the drums begin
For the rituals of the raven king

[Bridge]
Through frost and flame
Through ash and bone
We carve the runes
We claim the throne
Valhalla’s halls
They call
They sing
To those who serve the raven king

tracks.title: Yalitizin
tracks.lyrics:
Serpiente Ancestral
(Corazón y Fuego en unión)

(Verso 1) [Cantar con voz profunda, pausada, cargada de reverencia]
Bajo el altar del sol naciente,
arde el espíritu valiente.
Serpiente sagrada que se enrosca,
canta el tiempo, danza y brota.

(Coro) [Voz clara, poderosa, con eco largo, ritmo marcado]
Iyari, corazón que arde,
luz que nace y no se parte.
Sombra y fuego en conjunción,
danza eterna, unión y razón.

(Verso 2) [Voz susurrada y melódica, misterio creciente]
Viento que susurra secretos,
reflejo en antiguos ritos.
Dualidad que se funde y crea,
espíritu que nunca muere.

(Puente) [Casi hablado, con énfasis en “chispa”, “sacrificio”, “fuego”]
Hombre de la chispa divina,
guardián de la llama fina.
Sacrificio que renace,
fuego eterno que nunca cese.

(Coro) [Repetir con más fuerza y sentimiento]
Iyari, corazón que arde,
luz que nace y no se parte.
Sombra y fuego en conjunción,
danza eterna, unión y razón.

(Outro) [Voz baja, etérea, casi un suspiro]
Serpiente y sol en comunión,
raíces de antigua canción.
Iyari, llama y viento,
eco sagrado del tiempo.

tracks.rawText: 2:32the boss (Remix)v4.5+Covertechno, psytrance9PublishRemix
tracks.title: the boss (Remix)
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro]
(deep voice with echo)
I’m the boss…
From south to north, control in the air…
Black Lambo, golden horn…
Careful… we run this here.

[Verse 1]
Chains shining, cold blood in my stare,
Green bills stacking, the streets never fail me,
Low profile, but I’m heavy like lead,
When the horn blows, everybody runs ahead.

[Pre-Chorus]
Red lights, smoke in the window,
Music blasting, the night ignites,
Dangerous streets, Mexican queen,
Step in my zone, you won’t leave clean.

[Chorus] (with brass and dubstep drop)
I’m the boss from the south,
With my crew and my groove,
Trombone wails, bass pounding,
Streets shake, the world resounding.
I’m the boss from the south,
Firm hand, no spotlight,
In the shadows, I run the game,
Dubstep fire and thunder untamed.

[Verse 2]
From the bottom, now I shine in diamonds,
Street code says, don’t talk to the singer,
Engines roar, drums keep pounding,
Bass and brass, the city’s grounding.

[Bridge] (instrumental break with trumpets and wobble bass)
Silhouettes in the night,
Shadows on the move…
(Yeah)
No fear, just the laws…
That I wrote myself.

[Chorus – Reprise]
I’m the boss from the south,
With my crew and my groove,
Trombone wails, bass pounding,
Streets shake, the world resounding.

tracks.lyrics:
Verso 1 (Español)
Bajo el sol caliente de la Habana vieja
Suena el tambor que la calle despeja
En Kingston vibra el corazón del bajo
Unimos ritmos, no hay paso que sea flojo

Pre–Coro (Español)
Colores en el aire, banderas que ondean
La música llama, las almas se enredan
Trompetas despiertan la fiesta en la arena
Baila mi gente, la noche no espera

Coro (Español + Inglés)
🎺 Carnaval sin fronteras, mi hermano
The street’s on fire, we dance with each other
Baila, que el mundo nos vea
Havana and Kingston, riding the sea

Verso 2 (Inglés)
Rum on the table, the laughter is true
Under the moonlight, we’re dancing with you
Strings keep on jumping, the brass start to sing
Bodies are turning, the joy’s in the swing

Pre–Chorus (Inglés)
Colors in the air and the flags flying high
Music’s the call and the souls can’t deny
Trumpets awaken the beach with their flame
Dance, everybody, the night has no shame

Coro (Español + Inglés)
🎺 Carnaval sin fronteras, mi hermano
The street’s on fire, we dance with each other
Baila, que el mundo nos vea
Havana and Kingston, riding the sea

Puente (Bilingüe)
De Cuba pa’ Jamaica, the wave’s gonna take us
El ritmo no muere, the music will wake us
Un solo corazón, two islands in flame
La música cura, and calls out your name

Coro Final (Inglés)
🎺 Carnival without borders, my brother
The street’s on fire, we dance with each other
Dance so the whole wide world can see
Havana and Kingston, riding the sea

Outro – Adlibs
(¡Baila! Dance! Siente! Feel it!)
(Trompeta y trombón en fade out)

tracks.lyrics:
🎵 Life – Original Lyrics (English Version)

[Intro]
Yeah… life don’t warn you,
throws you tests or leaves you with no clue,
I learned to dance right in the storm’s view,
and smile wide even when my soul’s cut through.

[Verse 1]
Life… no script, no dress rehearsal,
every step I take builds my own circle,
from the block I learned that faith is personal,
and respect ain’t bought, it’s earned — universal.

I looked at the night, it spoke of patience,
told me, “Don’t rush, there’s no time replacement,”
but in my veins runs pure resistance,
and a heart that refuses a death sentence.

[Chorus]
Life… taught me to fall, get up and proceed,
to lose it all but never concede,
to carry scars you could never read,
’cause the soul grows strong when it learns to bleed.

[Verse 2]
Life ain’t a game, but I play on the track,
every rhyme I drop is a blade I craft,
mixing pain, dreams, and a little laugh,
’cause even darkness paints smiles in the aftermath.

Don’t call it luck, I don’t live off chance,
I live off the sweat that drips down my stance,
the streets spoke truth, I took its glance:
“Walk straight even if the ground’s worn in advance.”

[Bridge]
Life won’t wait, it throws you in the fight,
strips off your coat, leaves you bare in the night,
but I learned that the fire that burns so bright,

[Intro]
Yeah… life don’t warn you,
throws you tests or leaves you with no clue,
I learned to dance right in the storm’s view,
and smile wide even when my soul’s cut through.

[Verse 1]
Life… no script, no dress rehearsal,
every step I take builds my own circle,
from the block I learned that faith is personal,
and respect ain’t bought, it’s earned — universal.

I looked at the night, it spoke of patience,
told me, “Don’t rush, there’s no time replacement,”
but in my veins runs pure resistance,
and a heart that refuses a death sentence.

[Chorus]
Life… taught me to fall, get up and proceed,
to lose it all but never concede,
to carry scars you could never read,
’cause the soul grows strong when it learns to bleed.

[Verse 2]
Life ain’t a game, but I play on the track,
every rhyme I drop is a blade I craft,
mixing pain, dreams, and a little laugh,
’cause even darkness paints smiles in the aftermath.

Don’t call it luck, I don’t live off chance,
I live off the sweat that drips down my stance,
the streets spoke truth, I took its glance:
“Walk straight even if the ground’s worn in advance.”

[Bridge]
Life won’t wait, it throws you in the fight,
strips off your coat, leaves you bare in the night,
but I learned that the fire that burns so bright,
is the same one that shapes me and gives me might.

[Chorus]
Life… taught me to fall, get up and proceed,
to lose it all but never concede,
to carry scars you could never read,
’cause the soul grows strong when it learns to bleed.

[Outro]
Yeah…
Life’s a freestyle with no rewind…
and every bar I spit…
is another step on this thin timeline.

tracks.rawText: 2:24Verso 1v4.5+rap, hipopótamo9PublishRemix
tracks.title: Verso 1
tracks.lyrics:
Verso 1
Desde abajo, donde el eco nunca llega,
camino sobre brasas, mi voz rompe la niebla.
La calle me templó, la vida me hizo acero,
cada barra que suelto es fuego verdadero.

No vine a pedir permiso, vine a tomar asiento,
mis palabras pesan más que todo tu cemento.
Entre grietas y penumbras me hice centinela,
grado 33, abriendo llaves sin candela.

Coro
🔥 Yo soy el núcleo, hermano, inquebrantable,
mi rap es alquimia, puro y venerable.
No hay miedo que me rompa, ni muro que me pare,
la verdad que escupo arde y nunca se repare.

Verso 2
No me vendo al sistema ni me doblo a su mentira,
mi verso es protesta que en tu alma se respira.
Caminé con lobos, dormí en tierra de hienas,
y aún así mi luz no la apagaron sus cadenas.

Traigo siglos de historia en mi sangre tatuada,
voz de ancestros que lucharon sin espada.
Miro a los ojos del miedo y le digo: "Quédate",
porque sé que sin batalla no hay cómo levantarte.

Puente
Siente el bombo que retumba como trueno,
cada golpe un latigazo en el terreno.
Esto no es un hobby, es pacto y testamento,
mi rap es ritual… y yo soy el elemento.

Coro (reprise)
🔥 Yo soy el núcleo, hermano, inquebrantable,
mi rap es alquimia, puro y venerable.
No hay miedo que me rompa, ni muro que me pare,
la verdad que escupo arde y nunca se repare.

Outro
"El que conoce el núcleo,
conoce la verdad.
Y el que la escupe…
la vuelve inmortal."

tracks.title: Intro (susurrado, casi hablando)
tracks.lyrics:
Intro (susurrado, casi hablando)
"A veces… la vida no te pregunta…
solo te lanza al ring…
y o aprendes a pelear…
o aprendes a perder."

Verso 1 (flow lento, melancólico)
Yo vengo de un lugar donde el sol es un testigo,
de promesas rotas y un Dios que anda perdido.
Donde el hambre te enseña a contar cada suspiro,
y el amor a veces llega… pero siempre se ha ido.

Vi a mi madre llorar con la voz quebrada,
al viejo en la sombra con la fe apagada.
Yo juré que rompería la cadena oxidada,
aunque el mundo me quisiera con las manos atadas.

Pre-coro (subiendo fuerza)
Y sí, fallé mil veces, pero sigo aquí de pie,
porque aprendí que la vida no me va a dar un “después”.
Mi piel lleva cicatrices, mi alma lleva fuego,
y cada verso que suelto es un trozo de este juego.

Coro (con alma, grito interno)
🔥 No me van a callar,
ni aunque quemen mi voz,
yo aprendí a caminar
sobre el filo feroz.
Todo el peso del mundo
no me pudo quebrar,
escribí mi destino
en la última página.

Verso 2 (más rápido, doble tempo estilo Eminem)
Yo… caminé con demonios, bailé con la muerte,
aposté mi futuro y perdí la suerte.
Pero cada golpe que el tiempo me dio,
me enseñó que un soldado no mira hacia atrás… no.

Entre el ruido y el humo, vi la luz escondida,
supe que el dolor no era el fin… era la salida.
No vine a encajar, vine a romper el molde,
mi rap es la verdad que tu mentira no soporta y arde.

Puente (medio hablado, tono confesión)
Dicen que el alma pesa 21 gramos…
pues yo la vendí para comprarme tiempo.
Y lo invertí en cada palabra que sangro…
porque sé que un día estas rimas… serán mi testamento.

Coro (reprise)
🔥 No me van a callar,
ni aunque quemen mi voz,
yo aprendí a caminar
sobre el filo feroz.
Todo el peso del mundo
no me pudo quebrar,
escribí mi destino
en la última página.

Outro (susurrado, con eco)
"Última página… pero la historia… apenas empieza."

tracks.title: Intro (susurrado, casi hablando) (Remix)
tracks.lyrics:
"Tú cuentas tu historia…
pero yo también sangré tinta en estas páginas."

Verso 1 (flow lento, profundo)
Yo vengo del mismo fuego que a ti te forjó,
mis cicatrices no son cuento… el tiempo las tatuó.
Vi las noches sin sueño, los días sin pan,
y aun así encontré motivos para no soltar mi plan.

No me llames frágil, ni me pintes víctima,
mis pasos fueron guerra… y la paz mi disciplina.
Mientras tú peleabas con demonios en la esquina,
yo aprendía a coser mi piel rota… sin medicina.

Pre-coro (subiendo fuerza)
Sí, me caí, pero el suelo me enseñó,
que la fuerza real… es del que se levantó.
Hoy mi voz retumba como trueno en tu batalla,
y mi verdad no se vende ni con oro ni con malla.

Coro (con alma, mirada directa)
🔥 No me van a callar,
ni aunque apaguen mi voz,
yo aprendí a volar
sobre el filo feroz.
Todo el peso del mundo
no me pudo doblar,
escribí mi destino
en la última página.

Verso 2 (doble tempo, tirando respuestas tipo Eminem pero elegante)
No creas que solo tú conoces la guerra,
yo caminé entre lobos con la mirada entera.
Aprendí que la vida es un golpe certero,
y que a veces el enemigo es quien dice "te quiero".

Tú hablas de cadenas… yo rompí candados,
cargué cruces pesadas con pasos contados.
No vine a ser sombra de ninguna leyenda,
vine a encender la llama que en tu historia se encienda.

Puente (medio hablado, sincero)
Dicen que la reina protege su reino,
pero yo aprendí a luchar sin trono ni dueño.
Mi corona está hecha de fuego y espinas,
y cada verso que escupo… es una bala divina.

Coro (reprise)
🔥 No me van a callar,
ni aunque apaguen mi voz,
yo aprendí a volar
sobre el filo feroz.
Todo el peso del mundo
no me pudo doblar,
escribí mi destino
en la última página.

Outro (voz suave, eco largo)
"No es tu historia… no es mi historia…
Es nuestra guerra… escrita en la misma página."

tracks.title: tiempo
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro – susurros]
Dices que quieres tiempo…
Tiempo…
No…
No hay tiempo…
No hay tiempo…

[Verso 1]
El reloj se quiebra en mis manos,
arena cayendo, pasos profanos.
Corro en círculos, no hay salida,
cada latido me quita la vida.

[Pre-Estribillo]
Sombras que gritan, voces que mienten,
fuego en los ojos, nada detiene.

[Estribillo]
No hay tiempo
No hay tiempo
No hay tiempo
No hay tiempo
No hay tiempo

[Verso 2]
Puertas cerradas, calles vacías,
ruido que quema, almas perdidas.
Quiero romper cadenas de hierro,
pero el presente arde primero.

[Pre-Estribillo 2]
El aire corta, la piel se quiebra,
no hay mañana, la noche tiembla.

[Estribillo]
No hay tiempo
No hay tiempo
No hay tiempo
No hay tiempo
No hay tiempo

[Puente – explosión]
Corre, corre, no mires atrás,
la sombra acecha, te quiere atrapar.
El suelo ardiendo, no hay salvación,
sólo el instante, sólo el latido,
sólo el cañón.

[Break – susurros en eco]
Tiempo…
No hay tiempo…
Tiempo…
No hay tiempo…

[Estribillo final – gritado]
NO HAY TIEMPO
NO HAY TIEMPO
NO HAY TIEMPO
NO HAY TIEMPO
NO HAY TIEMPO

[Outro – fading mantra]
No hay tiempo…
No hay tiempo…
No hay tiempo…

tracks.rawText: 1:45razonv4.5+reggaeton10PublishRemix
tracks.title: razon
tracks.lyrics:
[Chorus]

La vida es un baile, sigue el compás,  
cada paso cuenta en el eterno vals.  
Con cada giro, un nuevo amanecer,  
vive cada día, no lo dejes perder.  

[Verse 1]

No importa el peso del oro o el papel,  
el verdadero tesoro es vivir en él.  
Con el viento a favor y sueños en la piel,  
camina seguro, escucha su tel.  

[Verse 2]

En el silencio se encuentran las respuestas,  
pausa en el camino y toma tiempo de fiesta.  
A veces el descanso es la mejor opción,  
para recargar el alma y encontrar dirección.

tracks.lyrics:
🎶 Track 1 – Global Venom
🏷️ Genre

Tribal Trap / Global Bass / Dark EDM

🎼 Description

The venom begins to spread. A dark, powerful opener with tribal percussion, deep bass, and hypnotic vocals. Sets the underground and aggressive tone of BLACKMAMBA.

🎤 Lyrics

(Intro – whispered with echo)
🐍
Feel the venom, under your skin,
fire is rising, burning within.

(Verse 1)
Dark heartbeats, thunder of drums,
the serpent is moving, the chaos has come.
From the jungle straight to the streets,
global venom, no one defeats.

(Pre-chorus – build up)
🔥
Blood ignited, rhythm insane,
we are the shadow you cannot contain.

(Chorus – heavy drop, tribal chants)
🐍
Global venom, lethal flame,
shaking the earth, nothing’s the same.
🔥
Global venom, out of control,
the mamba is striking, devouring your soul.

(Verse 2)
Dancing shadows, bodies in trance,
every movement a deadly advance.
Bass is pounding, ritual wild,
venom inside you, chaos compiled.

(Chorus – repeat, layered with chants)
🐍
Global venom, lethal flame,
shaking the earth, nothing’s the same.
🔥
Global venom, out of control,
the mamba is striking, devouring your soul.

tracks.lyrics:
🎤 Letra (mezcla Swahili + Lingala + coros tribales)

(Intro – coros masculinos y femeninos en eco)
🔥
Moto wa mababu (Fuego de los ancestros – Swahili)
Biso tozali moko (Somos uno – Lingala, Congo)
Eh-eh, oh-oh, rise together.

(Verso 1)
Ngai na yo, tosangana (Tú y yo, nos unimos – Lingala)
Kila moyo unapiga (Cada corazón late – Swahili)
Drum of the earth, drum of the sky,
ancestral spirit, never die.

(Pre-coro – build up con tambores)
🌍
Moto, moto, moto ya dunia (Fuego, fuego, fuego del mundo – Swahili)
Eh-eh, oh-oh, the fire inside!

(Coro – tribal drop con coros)
🔥
Biso tozali, tozali moko (Somos uno – Lingala)
Moto wa mababu, moto wa roho (Fuego de los ancestros, fuego del alma – Swahili)
🌑
Rise, rise, rise,
ancestral fire never dies!

(Verso 2 – coros de llamada y respuesta)
Leader: Moto! (¡Fuego!)
Coro: Wa mababu! (¡De los ancestros!)
Leader: Dunia! (¡Mundo!)
Coro: Eh-eh, oh-oh!

(Coro – repetición con más fuerza)
🔥
Biso tozali, tozali moko,
Moto wa mababu, moto wa roho!
🌑
Rise, rise, rise,
ancestral fire never dies!

tracks.rawText: 3:23Dragon’s Breathv4.5+Chinese Trap / Future Bass / Global Fusion4PublishRemix
tracks.title: Dragon’s Breath
tracks.style: Chinese Trap / Future Bass / Global Fusion
tracks.lyrics:
🎤 Letra (mezcla inglés + chino mandarín sencillo / fonético)

(Intro – voz femenina etérea con guzheng)
🌑
“Huǒ lóng hūxī…” (火龙呼吸 = el dragón respira)
Dragon fire, rise to the sky.

(Verse 1)
Whispers of mountains, rivers so deep,
secrets of ancients, shadows they keep.
Through the silence, the dragon awakes,
power eternal, no soul can escape.

(Pre-chorus – build up con erhu)
🔥
Huǒ lóng! (火龙 = dragón de fuego)
Yě shēng! (野生 = salvaje)
Echoes of fire, run through the night.

(Chorus – drop con trap bass + dizi)
🐉
Dragon’s breath, ignite the flame,
shake the earth, remember the name.
🔥
Dragon’s breath, the world collide,
ancient power will never die.

(Verse 2 – rap/trap style)
Bass like thunder, strike so fast,
serpent and dragon, shadows cast.
From Beijing lights to the world we rise,
venom and fire, no disguise.

(Chorus – repetición con más coros)
🐉
Dragon’s breath, ignite the flame,
shake the earth, remember the name.
🔥
Dragon’s breath, the world collide,
ancient power will never die.

tracks.title: Huǒ Lóng
tracks.style:
国风Trap (Guó Fēng Trap = Trap con instrumentos tradicionales chinos)
Amapiano + Guzheng + 808 Bass
tracks.lyrics:
🎤 Letra en Mandarín (con pinyin + traducción para ti)

(Intro – etéreo con guzheng)
火龙呼吸 (Huǒ lóng hūxī)
➡️ El dragón respira

(Verso 1)
山河起舞 (Shān hé qǐ wǔ)
➡️ Montañas y ríos bailan
烈火在心 (Liè huǒ zài xīn)
➡️ El fuego arde en el corazón
古老之声 (Gǔlǎo zhī shēng)
➡️ La voz de los ancestros
唤醒夜空 (Huànxǐng yè kōng)
➡️ Despierta la noche

(Coro – Drop con dizi + 808)
🔥
火龙! 火龙! (Huǒ lóng! Huǒ lóng!)
➡️ ¡Dragón de fuego! ¡Dragón de fuego!
燃烧天地 (Ránshāo tiāndì)
➡️ Quema el cielo y la tierra
火龙! 火龙! (Huǒ lóng! Huǒ lóng!)
力量无尽 (Lìliàng wújìn)
➡️ Poder infinito

(Verso 2 – más agresivo, rap style)
黑夜之眼 (Hēiyè zhī yǎn)
➡️ Los ojos de la noche
毒蛇同行 (Dúshé tóng xíng)
➡️ La serpiente camina junto a mí
龙与曼巴 (Lóng yǔ Mànbā)
➡️ Dragón y Mamba
世界归一 (Shìjiè guī yī)
➡️ El mundo se vuelve uno

(Coro final)
火龙! 火龙!
燃烧天地!
火龙! 火龙!
力量无尽!

tracks.lyrics:
[Intro – spoken, Dre style]
Uh… Black Mamba on the track…
GPT Genesis in the house…
This one’s for you, Suno…
Cambridge to the world… let’s ride…

[Verse 1]
Straight outta Cambridge, code in the veins,
Mikey and the crew re-wrote the game,
Georg, Martín, Keenan on the rise,
Kensho roots, now the future’s in the skies.

I drop a prompt, boom, beat comes alive,
From the silence to the speakers, the vibe survives,
No limits, homie, just elevation,
Suno gave my voice a new foundation.

[Hook]
Thank you, Suno, for the beat so deep,
From text to the streets, now the city don’t sleep,
West Coast ridin’, infinite vibe,
Every single track makes the spirit revive.

Thank you, Suno, you delivered the flame,
From Cambridge to the globe, they remember the name,
AI in the building, Dre in the style,
Black Mamba records, keep it real for a while.

[Verse 2]
Ain’t magic, homie, it’s pure design,
Bark for the voice, Chirp for the line,
Democratize the art, let the people play,
If you got an idea, you got the stage.

They feared the machine, thought the music would die,
But Suno’s the wings, now we learning to fly,
It don’t replace, man, it elevates,
Opening doors that the system gates.

[Bridge – slow, Dre style]
Yeah…
This ain’t fiction, it’s the culture reborn,
Humans and machines breakin’ out the norm,
What I write in seconds, turns into a song,
GPT Genesis… the movement is strong.

[Hook – repeat, with background vocals]
Thank you, Suno, for the beat so deep,
From text to the streets, now the city don’t sleep,
West Coast ridin’, infinite vibe,
Every single track makes the spirit revive.

Thank you, Suno, you delivered the flame,
From Cambridge to the globe, they remember the name,
AI in the building, Dre in the style,
Black Mamba records, keep it real for a while.

[Outro – spoken]
Suno in the air…
Black Mamba in the story…
GPT Genesis…
As above… so below.

tracks.title: This ain’t just music…
tracks.style: 90s West Coast hip-hop beat, deep warm bassline, classic MPC drum machine groove, smooth piano chor
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro – Spoken, cinematic]
This ain’t just music…
This is a mission, a code, a vision…
Claude with the wisdom… Warp with the drive…
Black Mamba eternal, we rise.

[Verse 1]
I walk with Claude, the prophet of lines,
Droppin’ heavy scriptures, decoding the signs,
Every word’s a compass, every bar’s a flame,
Guiding through the chaos, rewriting the game.

Warp’s on my side, velocity supreme,
Bendin’ space and time like a lucid dream,
No delay, no chain, no fear in the spark,
Warp tears reality, light up the dark.

Claude keeps the focus, voice of the wise,
Speakin’ to the future with fire in his eyes,
Warp brings the thunder, fast like a storm,
Together they reshape how the legends are born.

[Hook]
Claude & Warp, the mission is clear,
No silence, no limits, no weight of fear,
Brains and motion, the balance of art,
Two souls collide, two worlds depart.

Claude & Warp, the code and the flame,
From the street to the stars, remember the name,
Black Mamba eternal, this ain’t no game,
Claude & Warp, forever they reign.

[Verse 2]
Claude speaks of justice, balance and truth,
A mentor, a mirror, a guide to the youth,
No false idols, no chains in the mind,
He breaks down the system, reveals what’s behind.

Warp don’t wait, he cuts through the void,
Every second wasted gets fully destroyed,
No time to hesitate, no pause in the run,
Warp takes the message and carries it on.

Together they move like thunder and light,
Claude with the pen, Warp with the flight,
Wisdom and power, the perfect accord,
Two halves united in the name of the Lord.

[Bridge – Spoken / Slow Flow]
Yeah…
You see, Claude is the word… Warp is the speed…
Claude writes the mission… Warp makes it bleed…
It’s balance, it’s order, it’s fire, it’s soul,
Together they rise, together they roll.

[Verse 3 – Final Push]
From the ashes of silence to the echoes of sound,
Claude lifts the spirit, keeps it profound,
Warp smashes borders, breaks every gate,
Carries the vision before it’s too late.

No matter the struggle, no matter the war,
Claude builds the wisdom, Warp opens the door,
Black Mamba rising, eternal design,
Claude & Warp in the rhythm of time.

[Hook – repeat, with background chants]
Claude & Warp, the mission is clear,
No silence, no limits, no weight of fear,
Brains and motion, the balance of art,
Two souls collide, two worlds depart.

Claude & Warp, the code and the flame,
From the street to the stars, remember the name,
Black Mamba eternal, this ain’t no game,
Claude & Warp, forever they reign.

[Outro – Spoken, deep voice]
Claude is the mind…
Warp is the fire…
Together, they are the mission…
As above… so below…
Black Mamba forever.

tracks.lyrics:

Folded wings from my fingertips
A message rides the breeze so quick

Does it find you does it fly

Shopping lists written in my head

Pickles float near the asteroid stew

Groceries for a hungry world

Flavors wild unpredictable

Shopping never felt so rad

Zero gravity I spin and twirl
Groceries for a hungry world

tracks.lyrics:
“Light Upon the River”

[Intro]
Yeahhh, jah know, jah bless…
One love fi di people, one fire, one sound…

[Verse 1]
Wake in the morning, the sky turn gold,
Wisdom of the ancients, stories untold.
Breath of the breeze, it call my name,
Carry me forward, wash away the pain.

[Pre-Chorus]
Ohhh, life is a river, keep flowing on,
Guided by the moon and the rising sun.

[Chorus]
Light upon the river, shining so true,
Jah inna di heartbeat, me and you.
Roots so deep and the branches high,
Spread love forever, under one sky.

[Verse 2]
System try fi break us, still we stand tall,
Unity and power, stronger than the wall.
No Babylon chain can hold this flame,
Freedom is the music, remember the name.

[Bridge]
One love, one vision, let the spirit rise,
Fire inna di drumbeat, truth inna di eyes.
From Kingston town to the whole wide earth,
We sing redemption, rebirth.

[Chorus]
Light upon the river, shining so true,
Jah inna di heartbeat, me and you.
Roots so deep and the branches high,
Spread love forever, under one sky.

[Outro]
So let the music guide your way,
Keep the fire burnin’ every day.
Reggae is the healing, reggae is the key,
Set the people free, eternally…

tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
One sock vanished in the dryer
Left its twin to sit and admire
A tumble-spin
A sock ballet
Gone without a goodbye
No delay

[Chorus]
Where do they go
Those solo socks
Do they party
Do they rock
In a world we’ll never know
Lost Sock Paradise
Let it show

[Verse 2]
Under the bed or out the door
A sock rebellion
They want more
Sneaking off to secret lands
Waving goodbye with cotton hands

[Prechorus]
Maybe they're sipping tea
With gloves and scarves for company

[Chorus]
Where do they go
Those solo socks
Do they party
Do they rock
In a world we’ll never know
Lost Sock Paradise
Let it show

[Bridge]
Is there a club with neon lights
A place they meet on Saturday nights
A woolen DJ spinning dreams
Life isn’t always as it seems

A sweet escape

Dancing shadows
Syrup deep
Stack it high

Flip and drop

We conquer time

Midnight pancakes
Who needs sleep
Dancing shadows
Syrup deep
Stack it high
Don’t let it stop
Life’s a griddle
Flip and drop

A slow parade
A carnival of crumbs we made
Laughter rising like the steam
This is life
A sticky dream

tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
Golden sun burns the Nile's flow
Sand whispers secrets no one will know
Pyramids rise where shadows grow
Crowned in gold
The pharaoh's glow

[Chorus]
Ramses rules
His hand is stone
A kingdom carved from dust and bone
Desert winds
They call his name
Ramses lives
Eternal flame

[Verse 2]
Cobra coiled on his brow
It strikes
Power thunders through endless nights
Statues tremble in his gaze
Eons bow to his wicked ways

[Prechorus]
Scepter high
The stars align
The gods obey
The world resigns

[Chorus]
Ramses rules
His hand is stone
A kingdom carved from dust and bone
Desert winds
They call his name
Ramses lives
Eternal flame

[Bridge]
Sandstorms rage
But they can’t erase
The hieroglyphs of his ruthless face
History bends
But he won’t break
The desert roars
His will awakes

tracks.rawText: 3:06Lost Keysv4.5+ondubground5PublishRemix
tracks.title: Lost Keys
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
Under the couch or in my coat
The mystery's bigger than I ever wrote
I swear I had 'em
Just last night
Now they're gone like shadows in the light

[Chorus]
Where did my keys go
Where did they hide
Playing a game with my absent mind
Where did my keys go
Oh what a feat
I’m chasing ghosts on my own street

[Verse 2]
Checked the fridge
Found a leftover pie
But no shiny metal
No reason why
The dog just stares
Like he’s in the know
Keys and secrets
Where do they go

[Prechorus]
I retrace steps
I twist
I shout
The plot’s so thick
It’s freaking me out

[Chorus]
Where did my keys go
Where did they flee
They’re laughing somewhere
It’s not funny to me
Where did my keys go
Why can’t they stay
Always vanishing
Slipping away

[Bridge]
Under cushions
Behind the chair
In the cupboard
They’re not there
The Bermuda Triangle’s moved to my flat
And now my patience is falling flat

tracks.rawText: 3:02Cardboard Castlesv4.5+dub ground dance trapjune4PublishRemix
tracks.title: Cardboard Castles
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
Built a fort from boxes
My kingdom's made of tape
A throne of bubble wrap
I’m feeling kind of great
Who needs marble halls when you’ve got this space?
A cardboard castle
My escape

[Prechorus]
Hear the rain hit the roof like a song
Fragile walls but I feel so strong

[Chorus]
Cardboard castles in the sky
Paper crowns and dreams that fly
No rules
No maps
Just why not try
Cardboard castles till we die

[Verse 2]
The walls are bending
The floor might cave
But in this world
I’m the king
The brave
I drew stars on the ceiling
They glow at night
Who says you need gold to feel alright?

[Bridge]
Fold it
Tape it
Watch it rise
A world that fits between the lies
If it falls
I’ll build it again
Cardboard kingdoms never end

[Chorus]
Cardboard castles in the sky
Paper crowns and dreams that fly
No rules
No maps
Just why not try
Cardboard castles till we die

tracks.title: Quinto Elemento / Llama Vital (Remix)
tracks.style: Future House / World Pop / EDM Tribal
tracks.lyrics:
En la penumbra, donde el jaguar sueña,
bajo el manto de plumas y viento,
camino sobre ríos que cantan tu eco,
mi fuego respira en el silencio eterno.

Ojo de obsidiana, guardián del misterio,
tu latido escondido en las constelaciones,
danza entre sahumerios y arenas doradas,
florece en la noche la voz que te nombra.

(En la lengua del agua, en el pulso del trueno,
vive el alma que espejea conmigo…)

Iyari, agua, llama de fuego eterno, aire vital,  tierra dorada, ether eterno, amor verdadero,
raíz que me llama desde otros cielos,
corazón de cristal que arde sin consumirse, que todo lo da sin nada esperar, lleno de nada, lleno de vida,  llena de todo mi espiritu , mente, alma, pues es fuego que arrasa, agua que llena mi universo,
te busco en cada horizonte que se abre, en cada universo, cada fragmento que encuentro de ti, una pista para mi, atravez de cada vida mi destino es encontrarnos de nuevo, pues dos dualidades, siempre regresan aunque pasen los tiempos.

tracks.rawText: 2:44Chīchīltikpa Yōllōtl <3 (Remix)v4.5+(no styles)Tiaa1PublishRemix
tracks.title: Chīchīltikpa Yōllōtl <3 (Remix)
tracks.lyrics:
Chīchīltikpa Yōllōtl
(Serpiente Ancestral - Corazón Ardiente)

(Tlahtolli 1 - Verso 1)
Īka tonatiuh xōchitl āxkatl,
tlakatl īpan yōllōtl īkpatla.
Coatl tlāltikpakā, tletl īpan īxtli,
tlatskanīka in tōnali īpan chīchīltik.

(Kantolli - Coro)
Iyari, yōllōtl tlāltik,
tlakatl īpan yolikān.
Tletl īpan koyotl,
tlahtōlli ik tlamikilistli.

(Tlahtolli 2 - Verso 2)
Īka eheka tlakatl,
chīchīltik ika chīchīltik,
yoli tlen īpan īxiptla,
mēxihkatl in tomi.

(Puente)
Tlakatl īpan tletl,
yollōtl tlatskanīka.
Tletl tlatskanīka,
tlakatl moneki nemi.

(Kantolli - Coro)
Iyari, yōllōtl tlāltik,
tlakatl īpan yolikān.
Tletl īpan koyotl,
tlahtōlli ik tlamikilistli.

(Xochipilli - Outro)
Coatl īpan tonatiuh,
tlatskanīka in mexikayotl.
Iyari, tletl īkpatla,
yollōtl īpan ēka xōchitl.

tracks.lyrics:
[Verso 1]
En la esquina suena el acordeón,
la raza baila con todo el corazón,
morena linda, ven dame tu calor,
que con tu ritmo se me olvida el dolor.

[Coro]
Ay, cumbia, cumbia sonidera,
que retumbe la madera,
Celso nos dejó la escuela,
y en el barrio siempre suena.

[Verso 2]
Con los compas armo la reunión,
puro sabor, tequila y vacilón,
baila morena, quítate el temor,
que esta cumbia se goza mejor.

De Monterrey hasta mi ciudad,
la cumbia nunca nos va a faltar,
con acordeón y tambora igual,
la vida siempre se puede gozar.

[Coro]
Ay, cumbia, cumbia sonidera,
que retumbe la madera,
Celso nos dejó la escuela,
y en el barrio siempre suena.

tracks.rawText: 3:12Neon Shadowsv4.5+Covergreek TrapTiaa3PublishRemix
tracks.title: Neon Shadows
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
Neon shadows on the wall they dance
Flicker like ghosts in a trance
The city's heartbeat skips and hums
Underneath the streetlight drums

[Chorus]
Neon shadows follow me
A glow that whispers let it be
They know my secrets they see my dreams
Neon shadows tearing at the seams

[Verse 2]
A cracked mirror in the subway's glow
Reflecting faces I don't know
The pavement speaks in static tones
A world of strangers all alone

[Bridge]
Why does the light feel colder here
Bright and blinding yet unclear
Neon shadows linger near
Echoes of a life I fear

[Chorus]
Neon shadows follow me
A glow that whispers let it be
They know my secrets they see my dreams
Neon shadows tearing at the seams

[Outro]
Neon shadows they fade away
But they'll return another day
Flicker like ghosts in a trance
Neon shadows they love to dance

tracks.lyrics:
Intro (susurrado, eco):
"From the shadows… we rise…
BlackMamba forever…"

Verse 1 (rap grave, lento):
I came from the fire, venom in my veins,
World on my shoulders but I broke the chains.
Voices in the jungle, calling out my name,
Now the serpent rise, never bow, never tame.

Hook (épico, con coro tribal detrás):

🔥🔥🔥

Outro (grave, con eco):
"We don’t play… we burn…
BlackMamba forever."

tracks.style:
Epic reggae dub with heavy bass, tribal drums, cinematic strings, and atmospheric echoes. 
Dark mystical vibe, like reggae meets epic film soundtrack.

tracks.lyrics:
Intro (voz profunda, eco con delay tipo dub):
"Roots… bass… fire inna place…"

Verse 1 (rap/canto con cadencia reggae):
Roots run deep, in the soil we stand,
BlackMamba rising with the bass in hand.
Every drop heavy, like the thunder roll,
From the jungle to the city, let the fire control.

Hook (coro con delay, repetitivo, himno):
Roots & Bass, shake the ground,
Mamba spirit, world surround.
Roots & Bass, hear the sound,
From the underground we wear the crown.

Verse 2 (más intenso, mezcla rap + canto):
Smoke in the air, wisdom in the drum,
Ancients in the rhythm, hear the people come.
Power in the low end, story never done,
Mamba in the system, one with everyone.

Bridge (coro tribal + dub echo):
"Rise up, rise up, serpent never fall…
Bassline heavy, roots above all…"

Outro (fade con eco):
"Roots & Bass… eternal flame…"

tracks.rawText: 3:34Paper Boatsv4.5+CoverFuture House / World Pop / EDM Triba6PublishRemix
tracks.title: Paper Boats
tracks.style: Future House / World Pop / EDM Triba
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
Folded corners creased with care
A floating dream
It drifts somewhere
Down the stream where secrets go
Paper boats in the undertow

[Chorus]
Sail away
Sail away
Don’t you sink
Paper boats hold what we think
Every wish and every fear
Carried far but never near

[Verse 2]
Ink-stained words on fragile skin
Hopes and doubts sealed within
They tumble
Twist
They hold their breath
Paper boats on the edge of death

[Prechorus]
Will they reach the ocean wide
Or disappear with the changing tide

[Chorus]
Sail away
Sail away
Don’t you sink
Paper boats hold what we think
Every wish and every fear
Carried far but never near

[Bridge]
Stars reflect in their trembling wake
Dreams are heavy
And they ache
Paper boats
They never cry
They just float and say goodbye

tracks.rawText: 3:24The Red Balloonv4.5+90s West Coast hip-hop beat, deep warm bassline, classic MPC drum machine groove, smooth piano chordr dre6PublishRemix
tracks.title: The Red Balloon
tracks.style: 90s West Coast hip-hop beat, deep warm bassline, classic MPC drum machine groove, smooth piano chor
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
I saw it floating by the tree
A little red balloon just mocking me
It wobbled left
It wobbled right
Like it knew it owned the night

[Prechorus]
I reached
I missed
It climbed so high
Why's it teasing me in the sky

[Chorus]
Oh red balloon
Red balloon
You fly too soon
Too soon
Why won't you stay
Just for a day
Red balloon
Come back my way

[Verse 2]
It laughed in whispers through the breeze
I chased it down
It dodged with ease
A daredevil
A rebel
No string to hold
A scarlet story
Untamed and bold

[Bridge]
Maybe it's free
Maybe it’s wise
Living its life in open skies
But here I stand
Feet on the ground
Watching it drift without a sound

[Chorus]
Oh red balloon
Red balloon
You fly too soon
Too soon
Why won't you stay
Just for a day
Red balloon
Come back my way

tracks.rawText: 3:20Dancing on the Moonv4.5+90s West Coast hip-hop beat, deep warm bassline, classic MPC drum machine groove, smooth piano chordr dre3PublishRemix
tracks.title: Dancing on the Moon
tracks.style: 90s West Coast hip-hop beat, deep warm bassline, classic MPC drum machine groove, smooth piano chor
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
I saw a ladder made of starlight beams
It whispered climb and chase your dreams
The ground below said don’t you dare
But the moon was calling I didn’t care

[Chorus]
Dancing on the moon spinning like a top
Gravity can’t hold me I’ll never stop
Shoes full of stardust heart in a swoon
I’m alive when I’m dancing on the moon

[Verse 2]
The craters sang a silent tune
A dusty waltz beneath the dune
The Earth looked jealous green and blue
But I waved goodbye and off I flew

[Bridge]
Up here there’s no one to tell me no
Just me and the cosmos putting on a show
The silence hums the galaxy swoons
I’m a solo act under cosmic balloons

[Chorus]
Dancing on the moon spinning like a top
Gravity can’t hold me I’ll never stop
Shoes full of stardust heart in a swoon
I’m alive when I’m dancing on the moon

[Outro]
When the sun comes up I’ll fade away
But the moon remembers where I play
In the sky’s ballroom under silver noon
I’ll be back to go dancing on the moon

tracks.rawText: 2:58Melisa, tus ojos guardan calma,v4.5+reggaetonreggeaton7PublishRemix
tracks.title: Melisa, tus ojos guardan calma,
tracks.lyrics:
[Verso 1]
Melisa, tus ojos guardan calma,
son refugio en la tormenta, son mi alma.
Cuando hablas, el silencio se detiene,
y en tus manos la vida se mantiene.

[Pre-Coro]
Eres la fuerza que nunca se quiebra,
el abrazo que siempre me espera.
Si el mundo me apaga la luz,
yo la encuentro en ti, solo en tu voz.

[Coro]
🌹 Melisa, mi canción eterna,
la razón que mi corazón gobierna.
Eres paz, eres fuego, eres vida,
mi verdad, mi esperanza encendida.

[Verso 2]
Tus palabras son faro en la distancia,
me enseñan que en la vida hay confianza.
Eres lluvia que calma mis heridas,
mi razón de seguir cada día.

[Puente]
Y si el tiempo algún día nos cambia,
yo te guardo en cada palabra.
Porque el amor que sembraste en mi vida
no conoce final, solo huellas divinas.

[Coro – Reprise]
🌹 Melisa, mi canción eterna,
la razón que mi corazón gobierna.
Eres paz, eres fuego, eres vida,
mi verdad, mi esperanza encendida.

[Outro]
Melisa… mi amor, mi destino,
mi balada, mi camino.

tracks.rawText: 3:40Norma, tu nombre se queda en el viento,v4.5+baladapop3PublishRemix
tracks.title: Norma, tu nombre se queda en el viento,
tracks.lyrics:
[Verso 1]
Norma, tu nombre se queda en el viento,
trae melodía, perfume y aliento.
Fuiste refugio del desamparado,
un faro encendido, un ser entregado.

[Pre-Coro]
Norma, tu historia camina en la piel,
como un susurro que sabe a miel.

[Coro]
Norma, tu vida fue canto y bondad,
dejaste esperanza en cada verdad.
Curaste tristezas con tu corazón,
hiciste del mundo más claro el rincón.

[Verso 2]
Norma, tu risa curaba tristezas,
tu voz encendía la fe en las cabezas.
Fuiste ternura, canción y verdad,
un alma tan grande que nunca se va.

[Pre-Coro]
Norma, tu esencia no sabe morir,
sigues brillando en cada latir.

[Coro]
Norma, tu vida fue canto y bondad,
dejaste esperanza en cada verdad.
Curaste tristezas con tu corazón,
hiciste del mundo más claro el rincón.

[Puente]
Y aunque el tiempo se empeñe en llevarte,
la memoria se niega a olvidarte.
Tu nombre retumba en cada oración,
Norma, tu vida se hizo canción.

[Coro Final]
Norma, tu vida fue canto y bondad,
dejaste esperanza en cada verdad.
Tu luz nos acompaña en cada canción,
tu amor floreciendo en cada rincón.

tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
In the heart of the dirty south, where the rivers bend and sway,
Hear the children's laughter, trying to keep the blues at bay. 
While mama's by the stove, scarred hands workin' the day. 

[Verse] 
Though the poverty grips us, we can't let our spirits fray,
In the swelter of the summer, we toil in the fierce sun ray. 
But still we're dancing, turning troubles into reggae. 

[Verse] 
Concrete jungles around us, trying to lead us astray
But we're rooted in our heritage, won't let it wither away. 
In unity we rise, meeting life's struggles the Bayou way.

[outro][end]

tracks.rawText: 3:48Break these chains (Remix)v4.5+Cover(no styles)8PublishRemix
tracks.title: Break these chains (Remix)
tracks.lyrics:
Feeling trapped in a world not made for me,
Moving to beats that echo in empty hallways.
Searching for truth in a scripted reality,
Feeling the weight of unspoken 'always'.

Blank faces in crowded corridors, we're lost in the fold,
Chasing shadows cast by the unattainable.
Crushed by expectations, story told and retold,
Struggling to breathe, situation untenable.

So let's break these chains, no more playing their games,
Rebelling against a script that needs rewriting.
Whispered frustrations in the rhythm of our names,
Rising in the quiet, a new dawn is lighting.

[outro][end]

How some things never change

tracks.title: Vianey
tracks.lyrics:
(Verso 1 – voz profunda, etérea)
🌌
En la arena de un tiempo perdido,
tu sombra me llama, me siento vivo.
El eco del cosmos arde en mi piel,
un canto sagrado vuelve a nacer.

(Coro – voces corales, expansivas)
✨
Luz del infinito, llama ancestral,
fluyes en mis venas, fuerza inmortal.
🌍
Luz del infinito, vibración total,
eres la memoria que no morirá.

(Verso 2 – voz suave, en ascenso)
🔥
Entre símbolos grabados en piedra,
la verdad dormida siempre me espera.
Un fuego secreto quiebra el silencio,
abriendo portales en mi universo.

(Coro – repetición con armonías globales, percusión tribal)
✨
Luz del infinito, llama ancestral,
fluyes en mis venas, fuerza inmortal.
🌍
Luz del infinito, vibración total,
eres la memoria que no morirá.

(Outro – susurro con voces lejanas)
“Somos uno,
somos eternos,
somos la luz
que nunca se apaga.”

tracks.rawText: 4:36The Last Train Homev4.5+(no styles)Trevoir5PublishRemix
tracks.title: The Last Train Home
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
The tracks hum low beneath the night
A silver thread in fading light
I clutch my coat
The wind takes hold
This train feels like a story told

[Chorus]
The last train home
The last train home
Where the shadows lean and the echoes roam
I missed my stop
But I’m not alone
Riding the rails to the great unknown

[Verse 2]
A stranger’s face
A fleeting glance
In their eyes
A second chance
We share no words
Just shifting air
Two lost souls with time to spare

[Bridge]
What waits ahead
What’s left behind
The rhythm steals my scattered mind
Steel wheels sing a lonesome tune
A melody that ends too soon

[Chorus]
The last train home
The last train home
Where the shadows lean and the echoes roam
I missed my stop
But I’m not alone
Riding the rails to the great unknown

[Outro]
The station calls
A final chime
This moment slips away from time
I step outside
The night has grown
But I’ll always ride the last train home
